_comment: Placeholder values. Every number in this file is to be calibrated on dev (docs/design.md, section 7) before it is trusted.

stage1_extract._comment: Stage 1 line building. To calibrate on dev. Gaps and tolerances are relative to the font size except the word tolerances (points, as pdfplumber takes them).

stage1_checks._comment: Stage 1 page checks. To calibrate on dev. garbled_max and glued_max are shares of characters and words.

stage2_clean._comment: Stage 2 cleaning. To calibrate on dev.

stage3_sections._comment: Stage 3 heading and block settings. To calibrate on dev. font_ratio is relative to the body font size; space_above_ratio to the line height.

stage4_normalize._comment: Stage 4 heading mapping and document checks. To calibrate on dev. fuzzy_min is fuzz.ratio (0-100) on the whole normalised heading; leak_max is the share of target-looking lines allowed in other or unassigned.

stage5_entities._comment: Stage 5 settings. To calibrate on dev. current_year is set here (not read from the clock) so runs are reproducible; update it once a year. max_citation_chars: a publication entry longer than this is taken as several citations run together and fails its check; indent_tolerance_pt: how far right of the left margin a wrapped citation line must start for hanging_indent_split.
